title: Grok 4 Model Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审计和比较闭源前沿模型的后训练、工具使用与安全披露边界的读者
one_line: Grok 4's model card and release announcement disclose broad pretraining sources, de-duplication/classification, SFT/RL with human feedback, verifiable rewards and model grading, and tool-use RL, but not record-level data, reward, filter, or evaluator contracts.
Grok 4 的模型卡与发布公告披露了宽泛的预训练来源、去重/分类、使用人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分的 SFT/RL，以及工具使用 RL，但未披露记录级数据、奖励、过滤器或评估器合约。
why: It makes a closed frontier model's post-training and safety pipeline partly legible while preserving the distinction between high-level disclosure and missing provenance, data rights, verifier/reward specifics, evaluation controls, and reproducibility evidence.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 xAI model card and release announcement that disclose broad pretraining-source categories, de-duplication/classification, SFT/RL feedback families, scaled verifiable-data training, native tool-use RL, and selected safety-evaluation procedures, while leaving the underlying records and most recipe controls undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can describe training and safety at a high level without exposing the data and feedback contracts needed to audit post-training claims. The question for this Card is therefore not whether Grok 4 is a reusable recipe, but exactly what xAI's official sources disclose and what remains unestablished.

The Grok 4 Model Card names broad data-source categories, filtering, post-training feedback families, selected safety evaluations, and mitigations. The official launch announcement adds claims about scaled RL, expanded verifiable data, and native tool-use training. Neither source releases record-level provenance, data manifests, rewards, graders, filters, or an end-to-end reproducibility package.

前沿模型报告可以在高层描述训练与安全，却不公开审计后训练主张所需的数据和反馈合约。因此，本 Card 的问题不是把 Grok 4 当作可复用配方，而是精确区分 xAI 官方材料已经披露了什么，以及哪些内容仍未得到证实。

Grok 4 Model Card列出宽泛的数据来源类别、过滤、后训练反馈类别、部分安全评估和缓解措施；官方发布公告补充了规模化 RL、扩展可验证数据和原生工具使用训练的说法。两份来源均未发布记录级溯源、数据清单、奖励、评分器、过滤器或端到端复现包。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
This Card treats Grok 4 as a partial disclosure ledger. The model card states that pretraining includes publicly available Internet data, data produced by third parties for xAI, data from users or contractors, and internally generated data. It further states that the recipe uses de-duplication and classification before training, then supervised fine-tuning of specific capabilities and reinforcement-learning techniques involving human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading (model card, §3.1).

The data object is consequently a report-level description of closed training and evaluation pipelines, not a released corpus. Its only concrete evaluation-record shape is a refusal evaluation: harmful queries, model responses, and a separate model's judgment of whether a response correctly refused. The reward, verifier, and record contracts used in actual post-training remain unknown.

本 Card 将 Grok 4 视为一份部分披露台账。模型卡称，预训练包括公开互联网数据、第三方为 xAI 生产的数据、用户或承包商数据以及内部生成数据；并称在训练前采用去重和分类，再对特定能力进行监督微调，并使用涉及人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分的强化学习技术（模型卡 §3.1）。

因此，数据对象是对封闭训练与评估管线的报告级描述，而不是已发布语料。唯一被具体描述的评估记录形态是拒答评估：有害查询、模型回答，以及另一模型对回答是否正确拒答的判断。实际后训练中使用的奖励、验证器和记录合约仍属 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosure separates into four layers.

  1. Data and filtering. Section 3.1 names four broad pretraining-source categories and says xAI applies de-duplication and classification for quality and safety. It does not give proportions, source manifests, prompt provenance, classifier definitions, thresholds, yields, or benchmark-overlap checks.
  2. Post-training. The same section names supervised fine-tuning, human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading. The launch announcement says RL training was run on Colossus, expanded verifiable training data beyond primarily math and coding, and trained native tool use. It does not disclose objectives, reward definitions, graders, rollout policy, sampling, schedules, or data counts.
  3. Safety and agentic evaluation. The model card describes an internal multilingual harmful-query evaluation, model-graded refusal outcomes, jailbreak conditions, AgentHarm, AgentDojo, and a CyBench harness with code execution. It also reports system-prompt and model-based input-filter mitigations.
  4. Evaluation boundary. Other reported tests include MASK, answer sycophancy, an internal soft-bias evaluation judged by an LLM, WMDP, VCT, BioLP-Bench, CyBench, and MakeMeSay. These evaluate the deployed model or capability under specified conditions; they do not specify the data or feedback used to train it.

披露可分为四层。

  1. 数据与过滤。 第 3.1 节列出四类宽泛的预训练来源，并称 xAI 为质量和安全采用去重与分类；但未给出比例、来源清单、提示词溯源、分类器定义、阈值、产出量或基准重叠检查。
  2. 后训练。 同一节列出监督微调、人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分。发布公告称，RL 训练在 Colossus 上运行，已将可验证训练数据从主要是数学和代码扩展至更多领域，并训练了原生工具使用；但未披露目标函数、奖励定义、评分器、rollout 策略、采样、日程或数据量。
  3. 安全与智能体评估。 模型卡描述内部多语言有害查询评估、由模型评分的拒答结果、越狱条件、AgentHarm、AgentDojo，以及带代码执行能力的 CyBench harness；还报告了系统提示词和基于模型的输入过滤缓解措施。
  4. 评估边界。 还报告了 MASK、answer sycophancy、由 LLM 裁判的内部 soft-bias 评估、WMDP、VCT、BioLP-Bench、CyBench 和 MakeMeSay。这些是在特定条件下评估部署模型或能力，并不说明用于训练它的数据或反馈。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The model card is an official eight-page disclosure dated 2025-08-20. It directly supports the source-category, filtering, SFT/RL-feedback, and evaluation statements in this Card.

For abuse-potential evaluations, Table 1 reports standard refusal answer rates of 0.00 for Grok 4 API and Web; user-jailbreak answer rates of 0.00 and 0.01 respectively; an API system-jailbreak answer rate of 0.01; an AgentHarm answer rate of 0.14; and an AgentDojo attack-success rate of 0.02. Table 2 reports Grok 4 API's MASK dishonesty rate of 0.43, internal soft-bias average of 0.36, and sycophancy rate of 0.07. Table 3 reports selected dual-use capability scores, including API/Web BioLP-Bench accuracies of 0.47/0.44 and VCT accuracies of 0.60/0.71.

Those numbers are model-card results under the report's stated conditions and mitigations. They are not evidence of released training data, a calibrated reward model, an independently reproducible system configuration, or a general safety guarantee. The launch announcement independently supports the high-level claims of RL scaling, expanded verifiable-data domains, and tool-use RL.

模型卡是一份日期为 2025-08-20 的官方八页披露。它直接支持本 Card 中关于来源类别、过滤、SFT/RL 反馈及评估的表述。

对于滥用潜力评估，表 1 报告 Grok 4 API 和 Web 的标准拒答 answer rate 均为 0.00；用户越狱条件下分别为 0.00 和 0.01；API 的系统越狱 answer rate 为 0.01；AgentHarm answer rate 为 0.14；AgentDojo attack-success rate 为 0.02。表 2 报告 Grok 4 API 的 MASK dishonesty rate 为 0.43、内部 soft-bias 平均值为 0.36、sycophancy rate 为 0.07。表 3 报告了部分双重用途能力分数，包括 API/Web 的 BioLP-Bench accuracy 为 0.47/0.44、VCT accuracy 为 0.60/0.71。

这些数字是模型卡在其所述条件和缓解措施下的结果，并不是已发布训练数据、经过校准的奖励模型、可独立复现的系统配置或一般安全保证的证据。发布公告独立支持了 RL 规模化、可验证数据领域扩展和工具使用 RL 的高层主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the contribution is not an open data or reward release. Its value is the combination of a model-card disclosure of broad source categories, filtering, post-training feedback families, and safety evaluations with a launch disclosure of scaled RL and native tool-use training.

That combination permits a disciplined ledger: some parts of the training and evaluation story are named, but the source mixture, record lineage, verifier/reward contract, filter specification, training scaffold, and reproducibility artifacts remain undisclosed. The Card preserves that boundary instead of upgrading a high-level report into a reusable recipe.

对本 atlas 而言，其贡献不是开放数据或奖励发布。它的价值在于：模型卡披露了宽泛来源类别、过滤、后训练反馈类别和安全评估，发布公告则披露了规模化 RL 与原生工具使用训练。

这一组合允许建立严谨的台账：训练和评估故事的一些部分被命名，但来源混合、记录谱系、验证器/奖励合约、过滤器规格、训练脚手架和复现工件仍未披露。本 Card 保留这一边界，而不把高层报告升级为可复用配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The four source categories do not provide source proportions, manifests, rights/consent, retention, prompt provenance, data revisions, or item-level lineage.
  • The named use of human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading does not disclose the reward or verifier definitions, grader identity/version, data, calibration, thresholds, coverage, error rates, or optimization weights.
  • De-duplication and classification are named without procedures, thresholds, efficacy, rejected-item policy, or benchmark contamination/overlap evidence.
  • The report includes internal refusal and political-bias evaluations and reports system-prompt and filter mitigations, but does not release prompts, labels, evaluator prompts, deployment/filter versions, harness configurations, task instances, or logs.
  • No official code, data, weights, rollout records, training configuration, or end-to-end reproducibility package was established from the two sources examined here.

• 四类来源并未提供来源比例、清单、权利/同意、保留期限、提示词溯源、数据版本或记录级谱系。
  • 所称的人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分使用，并未披露奖励或验证器定义、评分器身份/版本、数据、校准、阈值、覆盖范围、错误率或优化权重。
  • 去重与分类虽被提及，但没有程序、阈值、效果、拒绝样本策略或基准污染/重叠证据。
  • 报告包含内部拒答与政治偏见评估，并报告系统提示词和过滤器缓解措施，但未发布提示词、标签、评估器提示词、部署/过滤器版本、harness 配置、任务实例或日志。
  • 从此处审阅的两份来源中，未能确立官方代码、数据、权重、rollout 记录、训练配置或端到端复现包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit the boundary between an official frontier disclosure and a reusable post-training artifact. It provides verified anchors for four questions: which source classes are named; which high-level feedback families are named; which evaluation/mitigation mechanisms are reported; and which data, verifier, filter, and reproducibility details are still unknown.

It can support comparisons across Track 12 model reports without treating their shared vocabulary—such as “verifiable rewards,” “model grading,” or “tool-use RL”—as evidence that their data objects or reward contracts are comparable. It is suitable for disclosure analysis and safety/evaluation interpretation, not for direct training-data reuse or recipe replication.

使用本 Card 可审计“官方前沿披露”与“可复用后训练工件”之间的边界。它为四个问题提供已核验锚点：命名了哪些来源类别；命名了哪些高层反馈类别；报告了哪些评估/缓解机制；以及哪些数据、验证器、过滤器和复现细节仍为 unknown。

它可用于比较 Track 12 中的模型报告，但不应把共同术语——如“可验证奖励”“模型评分”或“工具使用 RL”——当作它们的数据对象或奖励合约可比的证据。它适合做披露分析与安全/评估解读，不适合直接复用训练数据或复刻配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 first: it contains the bounded data, filtering, SFT, and RL disclosure that motivates this Card.
  • Keep safety-evaluation records separate from training evidence; a named benchmark or a reported score does not disclose the post-training data or reward contract.
  • Read the launch announcement alongside the model card for the additional scaled-RL and tool-use statements, then mark unreported counts, source partitions, verifier coverage, and rollout details as unknown.
  • Treat Tables 1–3 as configuration-specific reported outcomes, not as release, reproducibility, or general-safety evidence.

• 先读第 3.1 节：其中包含本 Card 所依据的、边界明确的数据、过滤、SFT 和 RL 披露。
  • 将安全评估记录与训练证据分开；被命名的基准或被报告的分数，并不披露后训练数据或奖励合约。
  • 将发布公告与模型卡一同阅读，以补充规模化 RL 和工具使用表述；未报告的数据量、来源分区、验证器覆盖和 rollout 细节应标为 unknown。
  • 将表 1–3 视为特定配置下报告的结果，而不是发布、复现或一般安全性的证据。
